course.title: BSc Biology (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester
quotes: Duration: 3 years Year of entry: 2027 UCAS course code: C100 / Institution code: M20
A-level AAB, including two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics (the Core Sciences).
35 points overall with 6, 6, 5 in higher level subjects, including two science subjects, normally Biology and Chemistry.
IELTS 6.5 with no less than 6.5 in any one component
Tuition fees for home students will be £10,050 for the 2027/28 academic year.

Tuition fees for international students will be £38,000 for the 2027/28 academic year. For subsequent academic years, the University reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year
